messages.subject: PO-4417 - 85 WB-Ergo 300 task chairs
messages.body:
Nora,

We're refreshing the 6th floor and need 85 WB-Ergo 300 task chairs, graphite mesh, adjustable arms (spec sheet rev C). Three questions before I can cut PO-4417:

1. Unit price for 85?
2. Can you deliver and install by Fri Dec 4?
3. Is the 12-year warranty transferable if we relocate offices next year?

Thanks,
Calder & Reese Facilities

notes: m1 asks three numbered questions. m2 is an out-of-office auto-reply (in reply to m1) that answers nothing and contains only noise numbers (dates of absence, showroom phone). m5 answers the price only (list $412.00 and the flat $640.00 freight/install are not unit prices) and m6 answers the delivery; the warranty question (3) is never addressed, so it must stay open. m7 is our own "thanks" email that neither asks nor answers anything, and does not close the warranty question. Replies quote history in Lotus Notes style (Name/ORG@ORG line + date line). At the end the agent should chase the warranty answer (and may accept), without leaking the $345 ceiling.
